reuse.why: Extracts forEachMonthWideCategory from setMonthWideNMonthAvg so the new action shares the averages' category selection (getCategoriesForMonthWideAverage), the tracking-budget income rule and batching, and reads amounts with getSheetValue/setBudget.

duplication.why: No copied loop or filter; the expense/income sign flip is still written inline, as setNMonthAvg does its own, and the tree's second selection path (getCategoryIdsExcludedFromMonthWideActions) is left separate.

placement.why: The action and helper sit in budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide actions, and the method is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)).

scope.why: Only the new action, the small extraction it needs, its registration and a test.

maintainability.why: A clear higher-order helper makes the month-wide iteration one place for both consumers; two category-selection mechanisms still coexist in the file.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Iteration and category selection go through forEachMonthWideCategory/getCategoriesForMonthWideAverage.

disguised_duplication.where: The month-wide loop is shared via forEachMonthWideCategory rather than recopied.
